messages:
maria: Quick note 11 Need a compact "mini bench" asset pack for launch week (mobile-first). Variants: latency tile, cost tile, quality tile + one explainer slide (16:9) for the webinar. Deliverables: PNGs (mobile & desktop sizes), SVG icon set, animated GIF for social, and Figma tokens. Localize strings for FR and JA. Deadline: EOD Tue.
kevin: Copy that. Do we want a unified sparkline style across tiles or unique charts per metric? Also confirm whether to include per-token cost micro-panel.
maria: Unified sparkline but different color accents per metric. Yes include per-token cost micro-panel showing relative cost vs baseline (not absolute dollars).
tara: Palette question: primary navy + teal was used last time; recall legal flagged contrast for small labels. Suggest primary navy + accent orange for deltas to meet AA. Will run contrast checks.
sam: I'll prepare 3 short headline variants + CTA for each tile and a 1-line methodology blurb for the slide footer. Will hand off for translation after initial copy.
design-bot: Task created: FIGMA-1447 "mini-bench-pack". Assigned: @kevin, @tara. Due 2025-05-13. Exports: PNG 600x200 header, tile 600x600, mobile 320x180, slide 1920x1080.
kevin: Uploaded starter file: https://figma.com/file/mini-bench-xyz. Artboards: latency, cost, quality, slide, svg-icons.
maria: Legal note: avoid superlatives like "fastest" or "cheapest". Use "latency-optimized" or "cost-efficient" instead. Include methodology line with link to our benchmark harness.
legal: Confirmed. Also ensure any numbers are labeled (p95) and assets include alt text and a short accessibility description. No comparative claims without citation.
tara: Plan: static PNGs, an animated 2s GIF for social cutdown, slide export, and a small SVG icon pack. I'll include tokens and a style guide snippet in the Figma file.
l10n: For FR/JA localization, please provide source copy in a separate text layer and an exportable CSV of strings. Include context notes for short CTAs (max 20 chars).
maria: Good. Please flag any copy changes early. Also add a tiny inbound-flow micro-diagram for webinar signup (6 nodes: signup -> confirm -> nurture -> webinar -> demo request -> follow-up). Keep icons simple.
kevin: Will add micro-flow to the slide as an inline graphic (SVG).
sam: Methodology draft: "p95 latency measured across standard gen workloads with default batching; cost normalized to baseline config. See methodology doc for details." Use footnote link.
tara: First pass ETA Mon 11:30am PT. Requesting 20-min review after upload.
design-bot: Review slot created Mon 12:00pm PT. Calendar invites sent.
maria: Thanks team 1 This pack feeds webinar slides, social launch, and inbound emails. Keep everything modular for quick swaps during review.
